# World Health Organization (WHO)

> The WHO is the United Nations' specialized agency for international public health, providing evidence-based guidance on diseases, health interventions, and global health systems across 53 countries including Europe.

WHO.int serves as the primary digital resource for global health information, disease prevention strategies, and public health interventions. The site features comprehensive coverage of communicable and non-communicable diseases, regional health programs, and evidence-based health tools and guidelines for practitioners and the public.

## Key Topics

- Public Health
- Communicable Diseases
- Non-Communicable Diseases
- Disease Prevention
- Health Systems
- Health Interventions
- Population Health
- COVID-19
- Mental Disorders
- Fact Sheets
- Health Resources
- WHO/Europe
- Health Topics Directory
- Treatment Options
- Health Tools

## Health Topics & Diseases

- [Health Topics](https://www.who.int/health-topics): Primary health topics directory for communicable and non-communicable diseases
- [Popular Health Topics](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular): Popular health topics directory featuring commonly accessed diseases
- [Dengue](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/dengue): WHO dengue fact sheet with symptoms, diagnosis, prevention, and control
- [Mental Disorders](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/mental-disorders): WHO mental disorders fact sheet covering anxiety, depression, and conditions
- [Herpes Simplex Virus](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/herpes): WHO herpes simplex virus fact sheet covering HSV-1 and HSV-2
- [Endometriosis](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/endometriosis): WHO endometriosis fact sheet on chronic disease and women's health
- [Heat and Health](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/popular/excessive-heat): WHO fact sheet on heat health risks and climate change impacts

## Resources & Reference Materials

- [Health Resources](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources): WHO resource library with health data, guidance, and educational materials
- [Fact Sheets](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/fact-sheets): WHO fact sheets on diseases, vaccines, and medical conditions
- [Publications](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/publications): WHO publications library with guidelines, standards, and regulatory documents
- [Tools and Toolkits](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/tools-and-toolkits): WHO health tools and toolkits for disease prevention and public health
- [Multimedia](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/multimedia): WHO multimedia resource library with media and archived content
- [Facts in Pictures](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/facts-in-pictures): Visual health facts and educational content in picture format
- [Podcasts](https://www.who.int/mega-menu/health-topics/resources/podcasts): WHO podcast series on health topics, diseases, and global health issues

## Regional Offices

- [WHO/Europe](https://www.who.int/europe): WHO Regional Office for Europe homepage covering 53 countries
